'''Romossobar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that was the site of the [[Place of Enlightenment Through Knowledge]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tarben Jenoquan]] was studying on Romossobar when he was briefly infected with the [[Dark Plague]].<ref name="The Old Republic" />
